rules: Raw source storage, normalized source records, canonical content, and staff publication are separate layers.
Owner approval authorizes ingestion; it does not bypass language, currentness, accessibility, scope, placement, rights, or representation review.
Never import 557 disposition records as 557 staff-visible pages.
Same business ID with a different content hash is a hard conflict.
An exact replay is recorded, not silently ignored.
Extra or missing records fail promotion.
All 25 current seed IDs remain in their own permanent collection.
The DHS logo is outside this import and must not be modified.

builtIns.rule: Generate cryptographic item hashes and retain the old labels only as aliases.

sourceSnapshots.rule: Snapshots preserve extractable content and capture receipts. They are owner-approved for ingestion and remain held from staff release until the required reviews pass.

importOrder: Verify logical source locators and hashes without copying redundant files.
Create immutable source carriers for raw files and source packages.
Import 578 normalized catalog records plus five built-in records.
Import 557 disposition receipts and preserve 26 consultant-only records.
Import 21 canonical families and 52 canonical child resources as 73 editable units.
Attach 73 audio objects to the matching canonical units; keep the podcast reference separately scoped.
Import the 25 seeds into their permanent collection without overwriting any canonical item.
Import candidate graph nodes and edges with their original trust and review state.
Import donor courses, summaries, guides, observances, and media into held review cohorts.
Run independent review gates and create staff publication decisions only for cleared revisions.

requiredAcceptanceChecks.assertion: The complete normalized set contains exactly 578 records and matches its SHA-256.
Five built-ins have stable identities and real SHA-256 values.
The 557 receipt IDs equal 552 staff source IDs plus five built-ins.
All 26 consultant-only records are accounted for and restricted.
The 54 records absent from the 524-row GitHub subset remain in source storage and none becomes a competing public page.
Disposition partitions equal 52 active, 462 merge, and 43 internal records.
Every disposition source ID appears exactly once in canonical source accounting.
The 52 canonical child IDs exactly equal the 52 active-candidate IDs.
The 73 editable baseline IDs exactly equal 21 family IDs plus 52 child IDs.
The 73 canonical audio IDs equal the 73 editable canonical IDs.
The staff publication view contains exactly 72 canonical entries before adding separately labeled seed or donor collections.
Same business ID plus different canonical hash fails the import.
Any missing or extra record in an exact batch fails promotion.
Title similarity creates a review suggestion and never automatic deletion or collapse.
Every staff-retrievable revision has passed all required review dimensions and has an explicit scope.
Under-review briefs are absent from browse, search, Ask, and citations unless the owner deliberately opens review preview.
No imported executable HTML can send data to an external endpoint.
The protected DHS logo hash remains unchanged.
All 22 local snapshots and all 12 Google Drive snapshots reconcile to the 47-entry owner ledger; incomplete extraction remains explicitly held.
The shadow stage contains 630 source items: 578 catalog records, five legacy built-ins, and 47 owner-ledger records.
The shadow stage creates zero staff publication decisions; owner ingestion approval never substitutes for staff-release approval.
